svg.aria-label: Bar chart: empathy training effect sizes, Hedges g 0.63 unadjusted and 0.51 after trim-and-fill adjustment for publication bias
svg.text: Empathy training works — and publication bias inflates the headline
Hedges' g from a meta-analysis of 18 randomised controlled trials (1,018 participants). A g of 0.5 is a medium effect.

g.text: After trim-and-fill adjustment for publication bias

svg.text: Even the adjusted figure is a real, medium-sized effect — but it is a training effect, not a personality transplant.
Data source: Teding van Berkhout & Malouff (2016), Journal of Counseling Psychology, 63(1), 32–41. Longest follow-up in the trials: 6 months.
